gap: No result ChatGPT got that I could open (The Office Journal under-$200 and under-$150, itechguides' Xebec/Trio guide) prices any named-maker screen from its own US store on 2026-11-21: Arzopa E1 $189.99, Mobile Pixels Fold $143.99, Glance 16" $151.99 and Duex DS listing from $183.99, with the SideTrak Swivel 14" at $319.95 on Target falling over the line.
standout_why: Compared against three pages I opened. The Office Journal under-$200 (updated 2026-09-11) gives only approximate 'at the time of writing' prices for a ZUMWALT P7 and three near-unbranded Amazon screens. The Office Journal under-$150 states no prices at all. itechguides' Xebec/Trio guide carries Amazon prices stamped 2026-11-21 for five generic listings, so dated prices are partly there already. None of the three prices a FOPO, an Arzopa, a UPERFECT or any Mobile Pixels model under $200. DeskFinds under-$200 returned HTTP 403 and the other eight results were not opened, so the gap is not established against them. My own reads were thin: Shopify stores rate-limited (HTTP 429) after the first searches and Newegg returned 403, so three of ChatGPT's four sellers were not verified.
decides: It confirms the lineup rather than changing the pick. Two added screens that attach: FOPO S1 ($144.00 through our link) and FOPO S7 ($180.00 through our link) both fit under $200 per the brief's partner table (not re-read by me today), which meets the two-linked-rows requirement. ChatGPT's two-screen alternatives are the Arzopa E1 at $189.99, which Arzopa describes as a stacked screen on its own kickstand, and a Laptomo dual 15.6" at $169.99 on Newegg that I could not open. One added screen: ChatGPT's UPERFECT 14" 2K pick stays unverified, and UPERFECT's own store search did not return it. The linkable one-screen options under $200 are Mobile Pixels Fold and Glance (no record yet) and probably the 13.3" Duex Plus DS at $183.99, though that variant-to-price match is inferred and needs a product-page read. Just over the line: Mobile Pixels Duex Max DS at $215.99 (brief) and SideTrak Swivel 14" at $319.95 on Target.
